stages.name: Observe
stages.instruction: A thin converging lens sits at $O$. A real object $AB$ sits to the left of the lens at algebraic position $\overline{OA} = p$ (with $p < 0$ for a real object). Move both sliders and watch the image $A'B'$ redraw. Notice how the image flips through infinity when $p$ crosses $-f'$.
stages.concept: Relation de conjugaison (Descartes): $\dfrac{1}{\overline{OA'}} - \dfrac{1}{\overline{OA}} = \dfrac{1}{f'}$. Grandissement: $\gamma = \dfrac{\overline{A'B'}}{\overline{AB}} = \dfrac{\overline{OA'}}{\overline{OA}}$. Sign of $\overline{OA'}$: positive $\to$ real image (right of lens), negative $\to$ virtual image (left of lens). Sign of $\gamma$: positive $\to$ upright, negative $\to$ inverted.

stages.name: Experiment
stages.instruction: Three ghost images are waiting on the bench. For each one, tune $p$ and $f'$ so your live image (orange arrow) overlays the ghost (teal arrow) in both position and height. Press CHECK to submit — you have 5 attempts total for the 3 ghosts.
stages.concept: Given a target image at $\overline{OA'} = p'^*$ with magnification $\gamma^*$: recover $\overline{OA} = p'^{*}/\gamma^{*}$, then $f' = \dfrac{p \cdot p'}{p - p'}$ from the conjugation formula. Or eyeball the ghost until the arrows line up.

stages.name: Evaluate
stages.instruction: The image is invisible. You are shown three targets as numbers: $(\overline{OA'^{*}},\ \gamma^{*})$. For each one, compute the required $\overline{OA}$ and $f'$ on paper, set the sliders, and press CHECK. Each target gets exactly one shot. Miss the sign of $\overline{OA'}$ or the sign of $\gamma$ and you are out of tolerance.
stages.concept: $\overline{OA} = \dfrac{\overline{OA'^{*}}}{\gamma^{*}}$ (from $\gamma = \overline{OA'}/\overline{OA}$). Then $f' = \dfrac{\overline{OA}\cdot \overline{OA'^{*}}}{\overline{OA} - \overline{OA'^{*}}}$ (from $1/\overline{OA'} - 1/\overline{OA} = 1/f'$). Keep the signs — a virtual image ($\overline{OA'^{*}} < 0$) forces $|\gamma^{*}| > 1$ and $\gamma^{*} > 0$.

labels.peek_hint: solve p = p'/g, then f' = p·p'/(p−p')
labels.tip1: drag both sliders — cross p = −f' to see the flip
labels.tip2: align the orange arrow with the teal ghost, then CHECK
labels.tip3: compute p and f' on paper before you touch the sliders
labels.exhausted: OUT OF SHOTS · RESET FOR NEW GHOSTS

1.1: Slide p far left (large |p|). The image should shrink and stay real (right of the lens).
1.2: Now slide p closer to the lens. Near p = −f' the image balloons and flips to virtual (left of lens).
1.3: Watch the arrow: γ > 0 means it points up (upright, virtual); γ < 0 means it points down (inverted, real).

2.1: Look at the ghost arrow: its horizontal offset from the lens is p'*, its height ratio to your object is γ*.
2.2: For a target (p'*, γ*): set p = p'*/γ*. Then adjust f' until the orange arrow lands on the ghost.
2.3: Closed form: f' = p·p'/(p−p'). Compute once, set both sliders, then CHECK.

3.1: You do NOT need to touch the sliders yet. Read the target numbers and solve on paper.
3.2: Step 1: p = p'*/γ*. Step 2: f' = p·p'*/(p−p'*). Step 3: set the sliders to those numbers, then CHECK.
3.3: Sign check: if p'* > 0 the image is real, so γ* must be negative (inverted). If p'* < 0 the image is virtual, so γ* must be positive and > 1.
